question: Garib Kalyan Rojgar Yojana was launched in 2020 by the Government of India to provide work for ___________ days.
solution:
The correct answer is __**125 days**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Garib Kalyan Rojgar Yojana** was launched by the Government of India in 2020 to address the challenges faced by migrant workers during the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• It aims to provide **employment opportunities for 125 days** in 116 districts across six states in India.
 
• The scheme covers areas such as **construction, rural infrastructure, sanitation, and agricultural activities** to ensure livelihood generation.
 
• It focuses on utilizing resources under various government programs like MNREGA, PMAY, and rural schemes.
 
• The target beneficiaries of the scheme are **returnee migrant workers** affected by the economic slowdown due to the pandemic.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MNREGA):**

 
 
• A flagship scheme of the Government of India aimed at providing at least 100 days of wage employment to rural households.
 
• It plays a pivotal role in generating rural livelihood and empowering women and marginalized communities.
 
• MNREGA funding is utilized in Garib Kalyan Rojgar Yojana to create employment opportunities.
 
 
 
• **PM Garib Kalyan Package:**
 
 
• An economic relief package announced in March 2020 to support poor and vulnerable sections during the COVID-19 crisis.
 
• It included direct cash transfers, free food grains distribution, and support for healthcare workers.
 
• The employment initiative under Garib Kalyan Rojgar Yojana complements this package.
 
 
 
• **Rural Infrastructure Development:**
 
 
• Key focus areas include rural road construction, water conservation, waste management, and housing development.
 
• Such projects under Garib Kalyan Rojgar Yojana aim to boost rural employment and improve living standards.
 
 
 
• **COVID-19 and Migrant Workers:**
 
 
• The pandemic led to unprecedented challenges for migrant workers, including loss of jobs and reverse migration.
 
• Garib Kalyan Rojgar Yojana was specifically designed to address these challenges by providing livelihood opportunities in their native districts.
